description.en: The application name of the live stream to prefetch.

description.zh: 预热链接保持的时间，单位毫秒。默认0是一直保持。
description.en: The duration to maintain the prefetch connection. Unit: milliseconds. The default value, 0, means the connection is always maintained.

description.zh: 自定义超时事件的触发时间。单位毫秒。
description.en: The custom timeout period for a timeout event. Unit: milliseconds.

description.zh:
预热区域，详细内容请查看RegionCode对应简码表格。

> 预热区域粒度海外是国家简码，中国或中国内地是各省简码。
> - 如果传入某个RegionCode后返回CodeRegionHasNoNode，说明对应区域没有L1节点覆盖，无法预热，可以更换RegionCode
description.en:
The prefetch area. For more information, see the RegionCode lookup table.

> For regions within China, specify the corresponding code from the "Region codes for China" table. For all other regions, specify the country code.
>
> - If the CodeRegionHasNoNode error is returned after you specify a RegionCode, the corresponding area is not covered by L1 nodes and cannot be prefetched. In this case, specify a different RegionCode.
The name of the live stream to prefetch.

descriptions.zh:
### QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
### QPS limit

The queries per second (QPS) limit for a single user is 10 calls per second. API calls that exceed this limit are throttled, which may affect your business. Plan your calls accordingly.
